name: Camera motion
responsibility: Eases the camera to where a wheel or a key sent it, a frame at a time
description: Each eased input changes where the camera is going. The loop keeps the zoom point under the pointer, ends when the camera is at rest and asks the frame clock for work only while moving. A pinch and a drag bypass this loop and apply at once; reduced motion also applies at once.

outgoing.label: the time, and a frame at a time
camera transforms when easing is disabled
